description: Forget one agent's learned baseline and score and relearn from its next 30 runs. For intended behavior changes (new model, new task) that left the agent permanently deviating. The reset is permanently visible: records and alarms stay stored, the agent carries rebaselined_at, and the reset itself is recorded as a rebaseline alarm naming the score/band it erased. Requires confirm=true and the human's explicit go-ahead.

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

name: rebaseline
title: Reset agent baseline
